summary: Frontend-only visual/z-index verification of SectionAnchors.jsx follow-up fix (z-30 + soft gradient backdrop). Tested Home (/) all 5 sections and /xo-vision-care-system all 8 sections at 1920x1080. Backdrop extends beyond text with soft right-edge fade (not a hard rectangle). Regression scroll behavior still passes: nav hidden before section 1, visible fixed-positioned through all tracked sections, active anchor updates via IntersectionObserver, click-to-scroll works. critical_code_review_comments: None.
